problem: Take advantage of crypto volatility to generate profit: scan a bounded universe, deep-dive the strongest candidates, produce a decision-ready trade brief (entry/exit/size/risk) per opportunity, and act on it via a simulated paper account. Ultimately an automated live trading agent.
founder_words: I want to build a super agent that will take advantage of volatility. A decision-ready trade brief (entry/exit/size/risk). watch for universe, but not all at once. discover new opportunities as deep dive. take advantage means to generate profit. and then act on them. an automated trading agent.

job.core: Each scheduled run: scan a ~20-pair liquid crypto universe with live public market data, measure volatility (realized vol / ATR% / range expansion / volume surge), rank and deep-dive the top 3-5, and produce a decision-ready trade brief (direction, entry, stop, target, size, reward:risk, thesis, invalidation) per opportunity. Then update a simulated paper portfolio.
job.scan_shape: universe scanned each run; only top candidates deep-dived; opportunities discovered fresh each run

criteria_summary: 1-5 trade briefs, each with direction, entry, stop, target, size
position size honors the 2% max-risk-per-trade rule
each brief cites numeric volatility evidence
risk defined per trade: stop present and reward:risk >= 1.5
paper portfolio updated: marked to market, stops/targets honored, caps respected

inputs.market_data: live public crypto REST APIs (Crypto.com / Binance public endpoints) via web/bash tools - no key needed
inputs.volatility_signals: realized volatility, ATR% of price, recent range expansion, volume surge vs trailing average

outputs.primary: decision-ready trade brief per opportunity (entry/exit/size/risk) + updated paper portfolio snapshot

memory_store.name: paper-portfolio
memory_store.holds: simulated account: cash, equity, open_positions[], closed_trades[]

execution_posture_v0: simulated paper account in a memory store (no broker credential); real live prices, real P&L math

evals.plan: rubric IS the eval; today's first verified brief saved as evals/case-01/expected.md (regression baseline); accumulating paper-trade P&L becomes the true eval over the first weeks
